column2: Paano gumawa ng compound component pattern?
column4: Gumawa ng parent component na nag-provide ng Context, at child components na nag-co-consume ng shared state

column2: Paano mag-set up ng shared context sa compound components?
column4: const ToggleContext = createContext(); function Toggle({ children }) { const [on, setOn] = useState(false); return <ToggleContext.Provider value={{on, setOn}}>{children}</ToggleContext.Provider> }
<Toggle><Toggle.On /><Toggle.Button /></Toggle> — ang user ay nagko-compose ng components

column2: Kailan gumamit ng compound components pattern?
column4: kapag may maraming related components na nangangailangan ng shared state at flexible na API

column2: Paano i-improve ang API ng compound components?
column4: i-auto-assign ang child components gamit ang Object.assign sa parent: Toggle.On = OnComponent; Toggle.Button = ButtonComponent;
